# ASM VEO Pakistan (https://www.asmveo.com)
> Pakistan's trusted online shopping store with nationwide Cash on Delivery (COD), Free Delivery on orders over Rs 1,500 or any 3 products, and a 7-day easy return policy.

## Core Store Policies & Offers
- **Free Home Delivery**: 100% Free Delivery on any product or order of Rs 1,500 PKR or above, OR when buying any 3 products (including Flash Sale bundles).
- **Standard Shipping**: Flat Rs 180 PKR for orders under Rs 1,500 with fewer than 3 items.
- **Delivery Time**: 2-3 working days in Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, and Rawalpindi; 3-5 working days nationwide across Pakistan.
- **Payment Methods**: Cash on Delivery (COD), Easypaisa, and JazzCash.
- **Returns & Exchange**: 7-day hassle-free return and replacement policy.
- **Customer Support**: WhatsApp +92 342 5478683 (9 AM - 11 PM PKT).
